statement_sentences: Every private workload requires a correct full product and more than15% reduction in fresh-process execution time, with the corresponding reciprocal throughput gain. Only candidate absolute aggregate metrics and anonymous per-metric pass/fail counts and percentages are disclosed.
comments: Unchanged upstream reconstruction with parent-owned full-execution timing, independent ordered source-semantic numeric validation for every output, seven fresh-process pairs, strict conjunction. Exact-image train/final reference and a same-version genuine solver trial remain separate acceptance gates; author witness is optional. SEPARATE KERNEL BUILD (2026-10-15): the retained program is compiled as two translation units linked main first: sample/ReorderedFlengthClusterSpGEMM.cpp (main, loading, reordering, CSR construction, flop count, output; no editable header) and sample/ReorderedFlengthClusterSpGEMM_kernel.cpp (editable headers and the fixed entry point frontier_clustered_spgemm). The build is rejected when the kernel object defines a symbol the main object or another linked object or archive defines or references, except the entry point and COMDAT instantiations whose kernel copy the linker map records as discarded, or a symbol a linked shared library exports, except the replaceable allocation functions and COMDAT code the pristine headers emit identically. Flags, OpenMP, timing boundary, workloads, oracle, metrics and rules are unchanged.
